lines.text: This is a boarding house in Legazpi, built small.
Thirty-three rooms. Thirty-two of them lived in.
For years, each room was a line in a spreadsheet, on one USB drive.
Rent in cash. Invoices in a paper book. Repairs, lost in a chat.
Hivelet connects every room to one place.
Rent comes in through GCash, and she verifies it.
A room reports a leak. It is tracked until it's done.
A stranger asks about the empty room, with no account.
Nine hundred thirty-seven of her records live here now.
Security, A-plus. Quality, four point five three out of five.
